businessDefinition.title: AI Recruitment Automation Platform — Business Definition
businessDefinition.author: DuyMT (with AI assistant)
businessDefinition.summary: Business objectives, KPIs, stakeholder roles, 140 business rules, 41 use cases covering candidate sourcing, CV processing, scheduling, assessment, pipeline management, translation, notifications, auth, multi-client operations, workflow engine, audit, human review, candidate portal, dashboard, AI governance, billing, and onboarding. Every BP, BR, and UC traces to REQ-* from Gate 2.

businessObjectives.title: Reduce time-to-hire
businessObjectives.description: Cut average hiring cycle from 45 days to 25 days by automating sourcing, screening, and scheduling

businessObjectives.title: Improve candidate quality
businessObjectives.description: AI-powered matching ensures top-ranked candidates meet ≥85% of job criteria

businessObjectives.title: Scale multi-client operations
businessObjectives.description: Single agency platform serves multiple employer clients with strict data isolation

businessObjectives.title: Reduce manual recruiter workload
businessObjectives.description: Automate ≥60% of repetitive tasks (sourcing, outreach, scheduling, reminders)

businessObjectives.title: Enable cross-border hiring
businessObjectives.description: JP/VN/EN translation and timezone-aware scheduling support international recruitment

businessObjectives.title: Ensure compliance and auditability
businessObjectives.description: Full audit trail, GDPR/CCPA compliance, configurable data retention

businessObjectives.title: Minimize AI cost exposure
businessObjectives.description: Stay within $500–$1,500/month AI budget with cost monitoring and circuit-breaker fallback

businessObjectives.title: Provide transparent AI decisions
businessObjectives.description: Every AI-generated score and recommendation includes human-readable explanation

businessRules.rule: A candidate must have a unique email address within an agency
Duplicate detection triggers when name + email + phone similarity exceeds 90%
businessRules.rationale: Balances precision and recall in deduplication

businessRules.rule: All candidate PII must be encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3)
Candidate data is scoped to the HiringCompany that sourced or received the candidate
Candidates may be shared across a recruiter's assigned clients via shared pool
Each job must belong to exactly one HiringCompany
Default pipeline stages are: Applied → Screening → Interview → Technical → Offer → Hired/Rejected
Clients may customize stage names and auto-transition rules
Automated stage transitions fire within 60 seconds of a trigger event (pass/fail/timeout)
An application cannot exist without a valid Candidate and Job
All times are stored in UTC and displayed in participant-local timezone
Scheduling suggestions must be generated within 5 seconds of availability submission
Interview bookings must fall within business hours (9:00–18:00 local per participant)
Automated reminders are sent 24 hours before each scheduled interview
Candidates and interviewers can reschedule via self-service links without recruiter intervention
AI matching scores are computed using weighted factors: Skills 40%, Experience 30%, Education 20%, Org Preference 10%
Weight values are admin-configurable per agency
AI matching must complete within 15 seconds per candidate-job pair
AI-generated score breakdowns must explain each contributing factor
CV parsing must achieve ≥90% field-level accuracy on test corpus
CV parsing and AI scoring end-to-end must complete within 15 seconds
When AI services are unavailable, the system falls back to rule-based processing within 10 seconds of detection
AI outputs are advisory-only; no consequential action is taken without human approval
System uses OpenAI GPT-4o as primary AI and Gemini 1.5 Pro as fallback
MCQ assessments must be auto-graded with 100% accuracy for predefined answer patterns
Assessment scores are available within 5 seconds of submission
Recruiters can configure pass/fail thresholds per job (0–100, default 60)
Recruiters can override any auto-pass/fail decision with a recorded reason
Supported language pairs are JP↔VN, JP↔EN, VN↔EN
Source language is auto-detected with ≥95% confidence before translation
Translations delivered within 30 seconds per document (up to 10 pages)
Translations with confidence < 80% are routed to a human review queue
Each agency maintains a bilingual glossary that overrides system defaults for client-specific terminology
Email notifications are sent within 60 seconds of trigger events
All candidate-facing emails include agency branding
Template-based emails support HTML and plain text formats
Pipeline progress reports are sent to HiringCompanies at configurable frequency (daily/weekly)
RBAC is enforced at entity level, not just route level
Cross-client data access is denied by default; queries filtered by client_id
A recruiter may manage multiple HiringCompanies but only access their assigned data
SSO (Google / Microsoft) is optional; MFA is optional for admins
JWT access tokens expire and are refreshed via secure refresh token flow
All user inputs are sanitized against XSS, SQL injection, and NoSQL injection
File uploads are limited to PDF/DOCX, max 25MB, with magic byte validation
All uploaded CVs are scanned for malware (ClamAV) before storage
API requests are rate-limited to 100/min per user; uploads to 10/min per user
All candidate data access events are logged with who, what, when, IP, device fingerprint
Data retention is configurable per agency (6, 12, or 24 months); auto-purge on schedule
Right to erasure and data portability are supported per GDPR/CCPA
Credentials and secrets are never hardcoded; managed via environment variables or secret manager
System maintains 99.5% monthly uptime SLA
Automated backups maintain ≤24-hour Recovery Point Objective
AI workloads scale horizontally via BullMQ message queue
AI circuit breaker detects failures within 10 seconds, resets after 30 seconds
Health check endpoints are available for DB, AI API, queue, and cache

assumptions.text: Agencies operate 5 clients on average with 10–50 per agency
assumptions.impact: Affects scaling architecture and pricing tiers

assumptions.text: Primary markets (JP/VN/EN) have distinct regulatory frameworks for candidate data
Recruitment agencies will adopt workflow automation incrementally
assumptions.impact: Must ensure manual fallbacks at every stage

assumptions.text: AI quality will meet ≥85% accuracy for matching decisions
assumptions.impact: If lower, manual review load increases and value proposition weakens

assumptions.text: Client companies will accept AI-assisted candidate ranking as advisory
assumptions.impact: If rejected, all AI scoring becomes internal-only

constraints.text: No model fine-tuning in MVP (prompt engineering only)
All AI outputs are advisory — never autonomous decisions
Assessment scoring is objective/MCQ only in MVP
No real-time AI interviewer in MVP

risks.text: AI provider outage disrupts all AI features
risks.mitigation: Circuit breaker + fallback provider; rule-based degradation

risks.text: AI matching accuracy below 85% erodes recruiter trust
risks.mitigation: Continuous evaluation, fallback to manual ranking, A/B testing
Encryption, access logging, penetration testing, incident response plan

risks.text: GDPR/CCPA non-compliance results in regulatory fines
risks.mitigation: Privacy-by-design, right to erasure, data portability, consent management

risks.text: AI cost overruns exceed monthly budget
risks.mitigation: Cost monitoring dashboard, alerts at 70%/90%, auto-pause non-critical queues
Confidence-based routing to human review, glossary management

risks.text: Cross-tenant data leak due to misconfigured queries
risks.mitigation: Mandatory client_id filtering, automated testing, security audits
Retry with exponential backoff, manual scheduling fallback
File type validation, magic bytes, size limits, malware scanning
Training, gradual rollout, transparent AI explanations, override capability

risks.text: BullMQ/Redis failure blocks all AI processing
risks.mitigation: Redis Sentinel/Cluster, health checks, circuit breaker
Glossary management, human review for low-confidence, cultural adaptation rules

risks.text: Workflow engine misconfig causes incorrect stage transitions
risks.mitigation: Rule validation on save; dry-run mode for new rules
Digest modes; quiet hours; configurable per type

risks.text: Data retention purge accidentally deletes active case data
risks.mitigation: Only purge expired data; soft-delete with grace period
